prose: John Gruber takes on Eli Tan's New York Times review of Meta's Muse AI agent - a review literally titled 'I Was Blown Away'. Gruber's headline answers in kind: he was not blown away by the rave. (Summary based on the Daring Fireball post; the NYT original is paywalled.)
highlights: Gruber rebuts Eli Tan's 'I Was Blown Away' NYT review of Meta Muse
His counter-take, by title: 'I Was Not Blown Away'
Summary based on the Daring Fireball post; NYT original paywalled
